title: espmap conformer ensemble (Atlas index)
description: computed/espmap/<slug>/<protocol>/ensemble.json: the Atlas's index of one espmap conformer ensemble for one Atlas compound or model. espmap computes; the Atlas checks that the molecule is the Atlas compound (canonical SMILES, then InChIKey), and that each member record is present, unchanged (sha256), an espmap.record/1 of this molecule (input.computed_smiles), verified by espmap (input.structure_verified, validity.input), neutral and closed-shell, of the stated geometry (geometry.sha1), computed with this ensemble's single protocol (analysis_key and key_fields.analysis) and espmap version. NPZ surfaces are not in git: they ship as release-bundle assets, verified against npz_sha256 when a bundle is built. When espmap's own ensemble record ships (v0.3), this file is replaced by a new schema version, never edited in place.

atlas_id.description: the compound or model record; its last segment is the directory slug

smiles.description: isomeric SMILES of the computed molecule. The identity check: re-canonicalised with the validator's RDKit and compared with the record's structure, so a standard InChIKey's merging of tautomers cannot pass a different molecule

inchikey.description: second identity check: must equal the record's generated InChIKey

protocol.description: must equal the directory name, e.g. b3lyp_def2-svp_gas_espmap-v0.2.1

analysis_key.description: espmap's analysis_key: the hash of its normalised calculation protocol, the same for every conformer of one ensemble; every member record must carry it

analysis.description: espmap's key_fields.analysis (normalised: xc, basis, solvent with vacuum as null, solvent_esp, grid, density fitting, geometry method, surface definition); every member record's key_fields.analysis must equal it

version.description: must equal every member record's provenance.espmap_version

selection.description: how the conformers were chosen, e.g. 'lowest 10 MMFF of 300 ETKDG, RMSD 0.5 A'

record.description: relative to the protocol directory; must be conformers/<conformer>.json

npz.description: release-bundle asset name, beside ensemble.json in the bundle; must be <conformer>.npz

rg_angstrom.description: radius of gyration of the heavy atoms

folded.description: the producer's extended/folded call; its rule goes in selection.notes

geometry_sha1.description: the member record's geometry.sha1; distinct across members
